$comment: rootDir is the repo root, not ./src. The API imports @weyos/shared-schema from SOURCE (it ships no build output yet — VEY-SCHEMA-GEN), and TypeScript requires rootDir to contain every file in the program. With rootDir ./src this was TS6059 by construction, which is why `nest build` and `nest start` had never worked. Emit therefore lands at dist/services/api/src/, and nest-cli.json points entryFile at it. Revert both once shared-schema publishes built declarations.
